An FMB&CO brand serving clients in the Philippines. Website: https://www.senzpr.com/

Professional services: strategic communications, brand strategy, PR, creative direction, websites, and scoped digital implementation.

Software: thirteen products with published monthly prices. Activation awaits verified release; request availability before payment. No automatic card checkout.
